checks.statement: a local period reads only the simple-pole coefficient
every higher principal power is an exact local derivative
the complete loop family is faithful on residue cohomology
the boundary-at-infinity row enforces total residue zero
one contour is deficient when cohomology has dimension >1

strength: exact genus-zero de Rham and zero-mode classification
verdict: The complete contour family is faithful exactly on punctured-sphere H1: it reads simple-pole residues subject to one global sum relation. Green normalization removes constants, spin-two reconstruction removes l<=1, and exact forms, higher poles, and delta derivatives are invisible to ordinary periods.
